concerns.text: Task T010.1 (MaxMin diverse sampling) is not linked to any Functional Requirement or Success Criterion in the specification; the spec never mentions a Max‑Min sampling step, so this task appears to be over‑reach.

Task T011.5 (Data integrity & checksum) is not explicitly covered by any FR. While data hygiene is a constitutional principle, the specification’s FR‑002 only requires preprocessing to handle missing values and ensure high confidence, not checksum generation.
Task T033 (Conformational‑limitations audit) has no corresponding FR or SC in the spec; the specification does not require an audit of rotatable‑bond limits.
Task T057 (Comprehensive validation audit) is not mandated by any FR/SC; the spec’s validation protocol only calls for a statistical report and Wilcoxon test.
Task T058 (Experimental validation protocol) is not required by the specification; the spec does not ask for a future wet‑lab validation protocol.
